caseStudy.title: Migros iMpuls
caseStudy.lead: Keeping iMpuls, the health and wellbeing app from Switzerland's largest retailer, stable, current and shipping on schedule.

brief.title: The brief
text: iMpuls is a production wellness app with an established user base. It needed to keep working on new iOS versions, follow backend changes and get builds to QA and the App Store.
The job was continuity: understand an existing codebase quickly, change it safely and keep releases predictable.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Maintained the Swift/UIKit app's behaviour and compatibility with current iOS versions.
Updated dependencies and moved the app to new API endpoints.
Worked on the AppAuth sign-in and session handling and on the WKWebView integration.
Prepared and distributed TestFlight builds for QA and supported release preparation.
Coordinated access and requirements with QA and the relevant stakeholders.

team.title: Team
team.text: Me as the mobile developer, working with a QA tester and the project lead on the client's side.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The app kept running on current iOS versions against the updated backend, and builds kept reaching QA and release on schedule.
